    return (".".join([path, *parts[1:-1]]), parts[-1])

        return "ERROR"
    calls = [p for p in phases if p["when"] == "call"]

    if case.find("failure") is not None:

assert inventory["git_at_start"]["tree"] == inventory["git_at_finish"]["tree"] == TREE
